building.name: 220 East 72nd Street
building.building_description:
220 East 72nd Street is a luxury building located in the heart of the idyllic Upper East Side. The Dermot Company has teamed up with New York–based JG Neukomm Architecture to reimagine this classic building with modern finishes and finely designed boutique amenities. The building, its residences, facilities, and the neighborhood combine to create an extraordinary living experience on the Upper East Side’s most coveted cross street.

The modern studio and one- to four-bedroom apartments feature large windows, warm gray tones, stunning wide-plank wood floors, and a Wi-Fi-enabled Nest heating and cooling system. Each home also features a washer and dryer for everyday convenience. Kitchens are fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, including dishwashers and wine fridges, as well as stunning quartz countertops. Bathrooms include porcelain tile walls and floors, as well as tastefully designed custom cabinetry and fixtures.

Take time off to work out in the fitness center or yoga studio, relax in the resident lounge, or enjoy the fresh air on the over 5,000 square foot landscaped roof deck featuring barbecue grills, dining areas, cabanas, dog run, putting green, and a bouldering wall.
